scenes.heading: Understanding the tools most VA clients expect you to know

sents.d: Understanding the tools most VA clients expect you to know
Familiarity with common business tools speeds up onboarding and builds client confidence.

Most VA clients expect basic familiarity with common categories of tools — calendar and email platforms, project management tools, communication platforms, and basic spreadsheet or document tools — even if they use different specific products.

Rather than trying to master every tool on the market, being genuinely comfortable with the most widely used option in each category (and confident learning new ones quickly) covers the large majority of client needs.
Listing your specific tool proficiencies clearly in your marketing materials helps clients quickly assess fit without needing to ask, and signals professionalism even before the first conversation.

take: Be fluent in the common tools and list them clearly.
